messages:
andrea_support: FYI customer reported our "High latency" and "Error rate" alerts firing all morning even though their traffic is flat. They attached screenshots of the console dashboards showing weird spikes.
matt_engineering: can you drop the customer id and a couple screenshots here? quick check: are the spikes on the raw ingestion or on the rollup/agg charts?
andrea_support: customer: acme-co, screenshots -> https://img.host/repro1.png and https://img.host/repro2.png. Raw ingestion looks flat in their raw stream, rollups show periodic big jumps around :15 and :45 minutes.
tess_data_eng: tagging in. this smells like an aggregation window mismatch. we recently toggled the default rollup for metrics from 60s -> 30s in the pipeline config during last week's perf deploy.
tess_data_eng: reproducing locally: query on metric p50_latency using bucket floor(event_time / 30s) vs floor(event_time / 60s) produces sample alignment shift. snippet:
```
SELECT bucket_time, approx_quantile(latency, 0.5)
FROM metrics
WHERE metric = 'p50_latency' AND ts >= now()-1h
GROUP BY floor(ts/30)*30 as bucket_time
```
this shows spikes at 00:00:30, 00:01:30 etc that the alerting job (still on 60s buckets) treats differently.
julian_sre: alerting rules are still using 60s aggregation. so alert -> evaluate -> compare to previous window misaligned. when bucket boundaries don't align the thresholds get noisy.
andrea_support: customer very unhappy; said they got a paging alert at 02:13 and it woke their oncall even though service fine.
matt_engineering: ok plan: 1) rollback rollup bucket change in the pipeline to restore 60s default for now, 2) update alerting queries to support 30s/60s alignment or use event-time-aware joins, 3) backfill/normalize aggregated series for the past 24h if needed.
julian_sre: created incident ticket INC-4587 and added runbook note about aggregation-window mismatch. i'll also mute the noisy alert on the acme-co org while we remediate :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy request #4281 queued by matt_engineering for rollback of rollup-config. canary: eu-west-1, eu-west-2
matt_engineering: kicking rollback now. will watch metrics and re-enable alerts after validation.
andrea_support: customer updated: they see alerts calming down, still waiting to confirm no further pages.
tess_data_eng: post-rollback check: alert evaluate job logs show consistent bucket alignment now. example log line:
```
[2026-03-04T02:18:00Z] alert-eval: metric=p50_latency window=60s buckets=1 match=false
```
julian_sre: will run a backfill normalization job overnight to merge 30s buckets into 60s for dashboard continuity. ticketed as TASK-998.
matt_engineering: follow-up: we should make alert definitions tolerant to small bucket misalignments, e.g., compare against sliding median or use max_over_time(2 * evaluation_interval).
andrea_support: closing loop with acme-co. they asked for root cause summary and ETA for normalization job. I'll send them the rollback confirmation and ETA 24h for backfill.
julian_sre: monitoring: no new noisy alerts for last 20m. keeping oncall notified for the rest of the window. :thumbsup:
